primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Relationship; printed p.16, PDF p.31
primary_records.original_meaning: Describes physical relationships to a parent and/or child components. Relationship has an optional parent Relation Link and a required child list permitting zero or more entries. Each Relation Link requires a UCI and a Link value; the sealed Link enumeration is ATTACHED or DETACHED.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: This is physical attachment information, not merely logical CIC membership, network connectivity or permission. The required child list may be empty; do not infer an actual parent or child, complete parts inventory, installed attachment, coordinate, offset or transform from the type definition.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Visible; printed p.17, PDF p.32
primary_records.original_meaning: The Boolean property is set to true when the laser is in the visible spectrum.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not architectural visible/opaque membership, discovery visibility, line of sight, display visibility, active laser emission or a measured detection. The definition supplies no numeric wavelength boundary or actual value for any case.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Relationship; printed p.110; PDF pp.125–125
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Relationship: optional parent Relation Link, 0–1; required child Relation Link list, 0+. The list can be empty. Original PDF125 text and page image inspected.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Relation Link; printed p.110; PDF pp.125–125
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Relation Link: required uci:UCI and required link:Link, each exactly one. Original PDF125 text and page image inspected.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.1 Link; printed p.80; PDF pp.95–95
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Sealed Link enum, standard since0.7.1: ATTACHED and DETACHED refer to physical attachment, not communication connectivity. Original text at printed p.80/PDF95 checked.
